how-20-02-compare.page: Put the flashlight beside one tray and the lamp above the other: drag them, or tap each one, then tap a tray. Press Let 2 days pass. Then swap them and press it again.
how-20-02-compare.say: Put the flashlight beside one tray and the lamp above the other: drag them, or tap each one, then tap a tray. Press Let two days pass. Then swap them and press it again.

how-20-02-det.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap a clue you see, then pick what it is. Predict if it grew toward the light or away from it, and watch its home appear.
how-20-02-det.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap a clue you see, then pick what it is. Predict if it grew toward the light or away from it, and watch its home appear.

how-20-02-write.page: What caused the plant to bend, and what does that tell you about how plants survive? Use at least one of the science words under the boxes.
how-20-02-write.say: What caused the plant to bend, and what does that tell you about how plants survive? Use at least one of the science words under the boxes.

how-20-02-partc.page: Draw the same plant on Day 1 and Day 7, side by side. Put the window on the right. Add arrows that show which way the stem grew.
how-20-02-partc.say: Draw the same plant on Day one and Day seven, side by side. Put the window on the right. Add arrows that show which way the stem grew.
